{{Quote|Don't think I can’t. I spent the last fifteen years in the Hapan navy, six of them as a squadron commander.|Benwick Chell|<ref name="DJ" />}}
'''Benwick Chell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hapan]] and [[Vonce]]'s co-pilot. A soldier of the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] at the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], he was a dissenter who disliked [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka's]] involvement in the war. He therefore joined the [[Peace Brigade]].<ref name="DJ" />
